name: PLS Sound
tagline: Record what your PC plays, straight to MP3.
overview: PLS Sound is the Pulse sound recorder and player. Press Record and it captures whatever your PC plays (a video, a browser tab, a game) exactly as you hear it, with no microphone and no room noise, or records your microphone. It saves a real MP3 at up to 320 kbps using Windows' own encoder. The player joins it next; a phone version comes later.

capabilities.title: Records what's playing
capabilities.text: Anything your PC plays, exactly as you hear it. No microphone, no room noise.

proofs.caption: A 3-second recording of what was playing, saved as MP3 (farm test PC)

capabilities.title: Straight to MP3, up to 320 kbps
capabilities.text: 128, 192, 256 or 320 kbps, made by Windows' own MP3 encoder. Nothing extra to install.

proofs.caption: MP3 quality picked at the top: 320 kbps

capabilities.title: Works with any sound card
capabilities.text: High-end cards at 96 or 192 kHz are converted for MP3; surround comes down to stereo.

capabilities.title: Level meters and a clock
capabilities.text: See the sound coming in and how long you've recorded.

capabilities.title: Your recordings, one click away
capabilities.text: Every recording is listed with its length and size: play it, show it in its folder, or change where they're saved.

proofs.caption: The recordings list on a 150 % scaled screen

capabilities.title: Records only when you press Record
capabilities.text: Never in the background. Closing the window while recording saves the recording first.

capabilities.title: Offline, light
capabilities.text: No internet, no account. About 21 MB of memory while recording.

note: Proofs come from the farm's Windows test PC. Please record only what you're allowed to: many sites, YouTube included, don't permit copying their sound except for your own personal use.
